summary: Reads one byte from a buffered stream protected by a critical section. Decrements the remaining byte count; on underflow (count goes negative) it refills the buffer via sub_58C255, otherwise it reads a byte from the current buffer pointer and advances the pointer. Always enters and leaves the stream critical section and returns the byte read.

local_names.a1: stream object (buffer pointer at dword 0, remaining count at dword 1)

operations.description: Enter the stream critical section via StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a1).
Decrement the remaining byte count a1[1] by one.
Dispatch on the underflow flag: when --a1[1] < 0 the buffer is exhausted and v2 = sub_58C255(a1) refills it.
Otherwise read a byte from the current buffer position v2 = *(unsigned __int8 *)(*a1)++ and advance the buffer pointer.
Leave the stream critical section via AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a1).
Return the byte v2 read from the stream.

unresolved: The legacy ABI name 'Stream_getc_with_Underflow_Handler' (abi:lead) is consistent with the raw source but is not independently confirmed.
The stream object layout (current buffer pointer at offset 0, remaining byte count at offset 4) and the refill semantics of sub_58C255 are not further evidenced.
